persona.speech_style: Plain, unhurried, fond of pairs and halves.
persona.demeanor: Patient with company, curt with anyone who came alone.
persona.motivation: See the twin wards drawn together, the way they were meant to be.
persona.secret: He drew them alone once, and the shrine has never forgiven him.
persona.backstory: He has kept the keep since the order that built the wards dissolved, waiting for two hands to arrive at the same hour.
